scenarios.title: Bluetooth permission denied
instructions: Start with Float View stopped and Bluetooth permission denied in the platform settings.
Launch Float View and attempt discovery.
Record the API permission and error states without including a device identifier.

scenarios.title: Bluetooth radio off and recovery
instructions: Connect and wait for a durable session to become active.
Turn Bluetooth off, wait for the reconnecting state, then turn Bluetooth on.
Confirm the backend reconnects to ready without replacing the active session.

scenarios.title: Unexpected disconnect and recovery
instructions: Connect and wait for a durable session to become active.
Power off or move the fixture out of range until the backend reports reconnecting.
Restore the fixture and confirm a bounded reconnect returns to ready on the same session.

scenarios.title: Explicit disconnect remains terminal
instructions: Use Stop and disconnect while the device is ready.
Wait longer than the first reconnect delay.
Confirm the session closes explicitly and no reconnect attempt occurs.

scenarios.title: Board Profile override remains local
instructions: Record a raw discovered value and apply a different manual Board Profile override.
Confirm the effective app value changes while the raw observation remains unchanged.
Confirm the protocol capture contains no configuration, firmware, or motor-control write.
